title: Starfront HD
notes: The exact IPA and exact-hash starfront-ipad-landscape patch passed an off-centre language-button tap on an ARM64 phone, completed the following load and rendered the Options menu. An active 3D mission, audio, pause/resume and release performance remain unverified.
